name: component-into-area
title: Insert Component Into Area
description: Inserts a React component into one exact construction seat or named data-area and adds its deterministic relative import.

settings.name: component
settings.title: Component To Insert
settings.description: React component name to insert, such as SiteNav.

settings.name: area
settings.title: Grid Area
settings.description: Optional data-area target such as header or main.
